summary: Commands are create-new-table, import-csv, and add-table-inline; defaults are default format, beta/csv/sticky disabled.
.table.md requires json-table-plugin true and a json-table fenced payload; save preserves body and rewrites table-links.
CSV import creates a persistent table; direct CSV view creates transient text data because JsonTableView returns before disk save.
Rename/delete listeners scan every table and update exact note-link cell paths, a broad write side effect.
Do not overwrite a .table.md file with raw JSON or rely on direct CSV editing for persistence.
